notes.title: 0.13.1 Fixs !
notes.notes:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where newly connected clients could disrupt other players' camera.
[*] Fixed rocket launcher self-kill bug: players could "kill themselves" and trigger killfeed/score, but wouldn’t actually die.
[*] Dash and Wall Jump cooldowns now properly reset on respawn/restart in JMP mode.
[*] Fixed dialog interface persisting over the ending event on the tutorial map.
[*] Fixed [i]startgame[/i] event not resetting score or player positions for connected clients.
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Last selected ARN map is now saved.
[*] Last selected JMP map is now saved.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.13.0 ! New JMP maps !
notes.notes:
[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] New JMP maps: Tutorial (S6_LWC), Tower (T_C17), Corridor (C_C17), and an "Old map" category with separator.
[*] Fixed JMP map issue where [i]end_area[/i] didn't check for [i]timerOn[/i].
[*] Added a velocity cap to physics-based projectiles (e.g. rockets are no longer too fast if the player moves quickly).
[*] [b]Major:[/b] Tutorial system implemented.
[*] [b]Major:[/b] Dialog system added.
[/list]

[h1]Graphic[/h1]
[list]
[*] Brought back the black outline for gamemodes HUD.
[/list]

[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*] New SOS sound effects added.
[*] Added announcer audio bus.
[*] Added landing sound.
[*] Fixed jump/walk sounds not playing when bhopping.
[*] Enemy explosions now spawn at the correct location.
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a delay before SOS explosions trigger.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.11.3 smoller update
notes.notes:
[b]Hey again, quick update while i'm still working on the things.[/b]
Still polishing things and squashing bugs while prepping the bigger stuff in the background. This one's mostly cleanup and graphics-related improvements, but it should make things looks better overall. Thanks for sticking with it.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] DirectionalLight now casts shadows for all players.
[*] General graphic adjustments.
[/list]

[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Temporarily disabled scaling3D due to visual artifacts.
[*] Graphics settings now properly apply when entering the game.
[*] Replaced the cube limit with a smoother triangle ramp in Threeway.
[*] Fixed multiple issues related to explosive bullets.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.11.2 smoll update
notes.notes:
[b]First of all thanks for keeping up with the game ![/b]
I'm currently working on better content, like remaking JMP maps to have complete environments in line with the game """lore""" or tweaking the arena game mode for it to be fun [i](if it's not in 6 months i'm scrapping it)[/i].
I've also started to work on a good Bot AI to fill in servers.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Grenade-Launcher refont (not finished).
[*] Increased all weapon hit slow.
[*] Shorten weapon switch time.
[*] Changed the explosion boosting mechanic to be more consistant (it needs adjustments).
[*] Remade the Jumper.
[/list]

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
[list]
[*] Explosion vfx ++.
[*] Reduced killfeed display duration.
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can now binds two buttons on the same action.
[*] Can now lock fps to a defined value.
[/list]

[h2]Fix[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed blood decals spawning at 0,0.
[*] Fixed third person weapon models desync.
[*] Fixed some sfx not playing.
[*] Fixed hitpoint desync issues.
[/list]
